mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.inventory_id, i.object_type, i.object_no, i.system_position_id, i.system_position_code, i.actual_position_id, i.actual_position_code, i.scan_status, i.diff_type, i.photo_urls, i.remark, i.scan_time, i.create_time FROM yms_yard_inventory_item i WHERE i.inventory_id = #{inventoryId} ORDER BY i.scan_status ASC, i.object_no ASC
